Welcome to Auto Miner!

🎯 Goal

Build an automated mining empire to maximize Silver production!

🚀 Getting Started

  1. Click to Mine Iron - Start by manually clicking the iron mining button
  2. Buy Iron Miners - Automate iron production (cost increases each time)
  3. Gather Resources - Use iron to buy sulfur and drills
  4. Mine Silver - Requires 10 sulfur + 1 drill per silver
  5. Scale Up - Buy silver miners to automate everything!

💡 Resources

  • Iron - Basic resource, mined manually or with miners
  • Sulfur - Costs 50 iron, consumed when mining silver
  • Drills - Cost 500 iron, consumed when mining silver
  • Silver - Premium resource, used to buy silver miners

⚡ Pro Tips

  • Use the Auto-buy checkboxes for sulfur and drills
  • Hover over buttons to see helpful tooltips
  • Red buttons mean you can't afford that purchase yet
  • Resource counters stay visible while you scroll
